output.summary: Arts has 2.7x the average ticket rate and a 9-day median against 3 days. SlotBook tickets, about 134 a month, are roughly 40% of Arts volume. They are routed to a P4 best-effort queue and the acknowledgement template gives no priority or timeframe, so requesters were not told. That plausibly explains most of the resolution gap. It cannot fully explain the volume, because Arts non-SlotBook volume is still above average. The evidence does not show who was told about RR-17, and it does not show an SSO link or the cause of any residual gap. Deprioritisation of Arts as such looks unlikely, since the rule is app-based. The Dean's insourcing proposal and a blanket P4 for all Arts are not justified. A written support agreement, a better acknowledgement and matched reporting are low-risk next steps.
